spec.assertion: dot{atkPct 68.46, intervalSec 1, durationSec 5, flavor sustained} appended once per full-charge shot. Proves: (a) load-bearing (base > 1.25x the atkPct-zeroed run); (b) 68.46 is the live magnitude (doubling atkPct exactly doubles the DoT delta, 1.98-2.02x); (c) instances STACK — RED under the nearest-wrong refresh/single-instance model, since collapsing durationSec 5->1 must cut the DoT delta by >2x; (d) sustained FLAVOR — RED if flavour-less/true/sequential, because zeroing the burst's 89.44% Sustained buff must then lower her total. Non-vacuity: skill1-sourced ticks occur both in and out of Full Burst.

spec.kitLine: FB enter -> ATK 47.52% of user ATK 10s
spec.assertion: casterAtkPct 47.52, durationSec 10, fullBurstEnter, self. Proves caster-scaling (buffApply value is flat and >1000, never the raw 47.52 — RED under a plain atkPct model) and static-ATK resolution (all applications share one value — RED under a final-ATK model); trigger identity via count === fullBurstStart count in the helm=true comp (RED under burstCast keying whenever helm completes a rotation raven sat out); duration via expiresFrame delta of exactly 480 frames against a durationSec 10->2 counterfactual (RED for 5s/15s or a round-count reading). Self-scope: no cross-unit application.

partsDamagePct is schema-inert in v1 (partless scope-lock boss). Asserts the line is accounted for (>=2 partsDamagePct effects at 21.12/5s, or a verbatim `unmodeled` record) and behaviourally inert (zeroing partsDamagePct leaves EVERY unit's total byte-identical). Over-credit guard: no raven-targeted buffApply may carry value 21.12 on any stat other than partsDamagePct — RED if the line is laundered into attackDamagePct/sustainedDamagePct.

Same inert-parts encoding on a fullBurstEnter trigger; covered by the same accounted-for + inertness + anti-laundering assertions (the >=2 effect count is what distinguishes it from the start-of-battle application alone).

it.skip — no part-destruction trigger in the schema and the v1 boss has no parts, so the line is unreachable; the A.N.-Mode exclusion gate is moot with it. Backed by a live OVER-CREDIT GUARD: zero buffApply events targeting raven with value 47.32. RED if it is smuggled in as a passive or FB-enter sustained grant, which would be the largest available over-credit in this kit (a near-permanent +47.32% on her dominant sustained channel).

flatDamage atkPct 492.3 at burst cast. Load-bearing (zeroing atkPct strictly lowers her total, patch-counter asserted non-zero) and FB-exempt (every burst-srcSlot damage event has fbMajorApplied !== true) — RED under a model that stamps the +50% Full Burst major on a cast that lands before the window opens.

sustainedDamagePct 89.44, durationSec 10, burstCast, self. Proves self-scope and magnitude; trigger identity via count === fullBurstStart count in the SOLO comp (raven sole B3 — non-vacuity: it fires every rotation) AND count <= fullBurstStart count in the helm=true two-B3 comp, which is RED for a fullBurstEnter mis-key that over-fires on helm's rotations. Duration read structurally off the committed effect (durationSec === 10) since the engine emits no natural-lapse event.

Moot while the Single Point Attack grant is unreachable (its part-destruction trigger cannot fire); no removal primitive exists for a timed buff. Covered by the same it.skip and by the 47.32 over-credit guard — if the grant never exists, its removal is untestable by construction.

fixtures: controlComp('raven', true) = BASE (liter B1 + crown B2 + raven B3 carry + helm B3) — the standard control; helm being a SECOND Burst III is what makes full-burst-enter vs burst-cast keying divergent and therefore testable. controlComp('raven', false) = SOLO — raven is the only Burst III, so every Full Burst is hers (unambiguous burst-cast counting for the A.N. Mode buff) and srcSlot-filtered damage events are attributable to her (liter/crown carry no damage riders). 10 hoisted runs total: BASE, SOLO, and 8 field-level counterfactuals (DoT atkPct 0 / x2 / durationSec 1, burst sustained 0, casterAtkPct 0 / durationSec 2, burst flatDamage 0, partsDamagePct 0). Counterfactuals mutate effect FIELDS in place rather than deleting blocks, so shot counts, gauge generation and rotation timing stay identical and only the patched line's damage moves; every patch carries a hit counter that the test asserts fired, so an encoding that silently fails to match is a RED, not a vacuous pass.
gaps: skill2 'when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part' -> Single Point Attack sustained 47.32% / 15s: no part-destruction trigger in the schema and the scope-lock boss is partless, so the line is unreachable. it.skip + a live over-credit guard asserting no 47.32 buff ever reaches raven.

burst Effect 1 'Removes Single Point Attack' and the S2c 'if self is not in A.N. Mode' gate: both operate on a buff that can never exist, and there is no removal primitive for a timed buff. it.skip, belongs in `unmodeled`.

skill1 DoT 'stacks up to 10 times': the engine appends one instance per fire with no per-DoT stack cap, and at RL cadence (chargeFrames 60, ammo 6, reloadFrames 141) the live instance count peaks near 4 — the cap is NON-BINDING in this fixture, so cap-enforcing and cap-free models are indistinguishable here. it.skip, flagged rather than faked.

MEASUREMENT-GATED (always-flag): the DoT's crit eligibility (global DOT_CRIT gate is default-off; per-DoT crit:true is opt-in only where measured) and any per-kit noFb exemption on the ticks (default OFF, measured-only). Both need a popup read of the 68.46% ticks; the blind reading leaves them unset.

MEASUREMENT-GATED (always-flag): raven's cadence tuple is datamine-sourced (rate_of_fire / reloadFrames 141 are known-unreliable fields). The stacking assertion is written as an inequality with wide margin (>2x) rather than an exact overlap count precisely so it survives a cadence correction.
